verdict.rationale: Name.com's own docs list domain lock management among the domain settings it exposes, so some locking capability exists. Nothing shows transfer lock applied by default, and nothing mentions a registry-lock option. missing for 10: evidence of transfer lock enabled by default, a registry-lock offering for high-value domains, dedicated lock API/docs detail, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, my domains can be locked down — transfer lock by default and a registry-lock option for the domains that must never move
